decision: Use a single-host RabbitMQ plus backend PostgreSQL staged pipeline with final domain writes through the backend Worker DB API during initial cutover.
non_decisions: This ADR does not enable production writes.
This ADR does not deploy RabbitMQ, service containers, PostgreSQL schemas, or worker service code.
This ADR does not change legacy Cloudflare Worker ingestion, Worker bindings, Cloudflare secrets, DNS failover, or routes.
This ADR does not move Grafana Cloud resource management from nutsnews-infra.

reason_to_change.scheduler: feed cadence, sharding, lease, and queue publication policy
reason_to_change.fetcher: RSS/Atom fetch, parse, feed health, and fetch error normalization
reason_to_change.canonicalizer: URL normalization, duplicate suppression, and canonical candidate selection
reason_to_change.approval: local prefilter, Qwen/local AI review, provider metadata, and approval decisions
reason_to_change.translation: summary translation tasks, language coverage, and quality samples
reason_to_change.persistence: idempotent final domain write requests through the backend Worker DB API
reason_to_change.publication: translation-gated publish decisions and public-feed snapshot refresh

message_contract.poison_message_policy: after bounded attempts, park message in route DLQ, persist sanitized failure metadata, alert through backend telemetry, and require explicit replay
message_contract.version_checks: Each consumer rejects unsupported schema_version/operation_version to DLQ with stale-version metadata instead of trying to coerce payloads.

state_and_recovery_model.authoritative_state: backend PostgreSQL stage schemas with inbox, outbox, attempt, reconciliation, and watermark tables
state_and_recovery_model.transport_role: RabbitMQ is durable transport and backpressure surface, not the only copy and not the disaster-recovery source.
broker_loss_recovery: Rebuild RabbitMQ topology from backend-owned Ansible/config before replay.
Replay pending stage outbox rows that have no confirmed downstream commit.
Use per-stage reconciliation watermarks to avoid duplicate final domain writes.
Run shadow parity checks before production-write resume.
state_and_recovery_model.duplicate_replay_policy: All stages are idempotent by message_id plus natural domain keys; replay is expected and must not create duplicate article/review/summary/domain rows.
state_and_recovery_model.watermark_policy: Every stage records processed watermark and confirmed publish watermark. Cutover proof requires no lagging stage watermark, no unbounded DLQ, and no unverified outbox rows.
state_and_recovery_model.backup_boundary: Backend PostgreSQL backups protect stage state. RabbitMQ queue contents are recoverable from stage outbox/reconciliation state.

ownership.area: backend.nutsnews.com host, RabbitMQ, service Compose/Ansible, PostgreSQL roles/schemas, backups, backend Alloy telemetry producer
Grafana Cloud folders, dashboards, alert rules, contact points, Synthetic Monitoring, quota guardrails, and management service accounts
worker stage source code and container image definitions
public web app and admin UI code
shared explanatory diagrams and cross-repo operating guide
legacy Cloudflare Worker ingestion and DNS failover controller until explicit retirement

deployment_model.single_node_ha_statement: A single RabbitMQ node is not high availability.
scaling_exit_criteria: sustained queue backlog exceeds recovery SLO under measured host headroom
RabbitMQ disk or memory alarms recur under normal workload
consumer saturation persists after per-stage concurrency tuning
backend PostgreSQL stage-state write latency threatens pipeline SLO
recovery tests show single-node broker loss cannot meet proof requirements
deployment_model.managed_or_multinode_trigger: Move to managed RabbitMQ or a reviewed multi-node design when any scaling exit criterion is met for two consecutive observation windows or before workload growth makes broker recovery proof fail.
rejected_scope: direct final domain writes from stage services

shadow_cutover_and_rollback.legacy_worker_status: Legacy Cloudflare Worker ingestion remains active production owner until proof/readiness and cutover issues approve replacement.
shadow_cutover_and_rollback.dns_failover_status: Cloudflare DNS failover controller remains independent and active after ingestion cutover.
shadow_cutover_and_rollback.shadow_mode: Run pipeline with production-like messages and backend_postgres_shadow/domain writes disabled except safe validation artifacts.
production_write_gate: NUTSNEWS_BACKEND_WORKER_API_WRITES_ENABLED must remain false until cutover approval.
Stage services cannot bypass the backend Worker DB API for final domain writes.
Publication requires translation gate and snapshot refresh proof.
proof_requirements: fixture parity against legacy cases from docs/worker-uplift-legacy-parity-baseline.md
shadow run metrics with no unbounded DLQ
backup and restore proof for stage PostgreSQL state
rollback rehearsal that keeps legacy Worker production owner
rollback: Before cutover, discard or pause uplift writes and keep legacy Worker as production owner.
During observation window, stop scheduler and producers first, drain consumers, compare watermarks, and leave DNS failover untouched.
After backend-only writes exceed a verified rollback sync point, rollback becomes forward recovery unless a reviewed sync-back procedure exists.

failure_behavior.duplicate_message: Consumer checks stage inbox/natural keys and returns success without duplicate downstream publish when already processed.
failure_behavior.replay: Replay starts from stage outbox/reconciliation state, not queue memory.
failure_behavior.broker_loss: Recover topology, then replay durable stage outbox rows.
failure_behavior.poison_message: Bounded attempts then DLQ with sanitized metadata and alert.
failure_behavior.translation_policy: Accepted rows remain translation_pending until all configured languages exist; publication is blocked by backend API translation gate.
failure_behavior.stale_version: Unsupported schema_version or operation_version goes to DLQ and blocks cutover until resolved.
failure_behavior.backend_api_failure: Stage records failed write attempt, does not ack until durable retry state is committed, and never reports success for partial final writes.
